verdict.rationale: Blaxel's docs describe sandbox images (templates) that create customized, reusable sandbox environments. These images are built from Dockerfiles with pre-configured tools, languages, and frameworks, and new sandboxes deploy from them in seconds. That covers both custom templates and bringing your own container definition. missing for 10: explicit evidence of using an existing pre-built image from an external registry, independent or hands-on corroboration.
